description.value: Caveman Cafe — branded 'King of Keto' — is a health-focused restaurant and keto/paleo/vegan bakery at its Tinseltown location in downtown Vancouver. The menu spans globally-inspired dishes including burritos, butter chicken, keto pizza, and grass-fed steaks, all made with whole-food ingredients and zero processed foods or refined sugar. It actively caters to a wide range of dietary protocols — keto, paleo, vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free — with generous, fully customizable portions.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 52m; stands (4 spaces) at 61m; stands (3 spaces) at 78m; rack at 98m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the 508 Abbott Street address and identifies this location explicitly as 'KETO CAVEMAN CAFE (TINSELTOWN)' on the contact page, corroborating the OSM record. Takeout and delivery are prominently advertised on the front page ('DINE-IN, TAKE-OUT OR DELIVERY'), and vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free options are explicitly described in the menu section. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields remain null per evidence rules.
concerns: OSM name 'Keto Caveman' is truncated; website contact page identifies this location as 'KETO CAVEMAN CAFE (TINSELTOWN)' — the full branded name differs from the OSM record.
OSM record contains no phone number; phone 604-700-2504 sourced from website contact page for the 508 Abbott St location only.
Website footer unexpectedly references 'Cotto Enoteca Pizzeria' as a related entity and credits the copyright to that brand — likely a website template artifact, but worth noting.
Website hours page shows a typo ('Friday to Saturday 11:00pm to 1:00am' likely means 11:00am) — minor data quality issue on the source site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active dine-in cafe in downtown Vancouver with confirmed takeout, broad dietary-protocol coverage (keto, vegan, GF), and a location convenient for cyclists passing through the Tinseltown/Gastown corridor. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but the food stop value is clear.
enrichment_extras.notes: Two locations listed on the website: 508 Abbott St (Tinseltown) and 4331 Main Street. This record corresponds to the Abbott St location only.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly lists 'Many Vegetarian and Vegan Options – Plant-based entrees and raw-vegan dessert items that are Gluten-free and nutrient-dense'; menu filter covers paleo, vegan, vegetarian, and gluten-free
